home.heroTitleBefore: Build a landing page from blocks
home.heroTitleAccent: and publish it in one click.
home.heroSubtitle: Paxl is a visual landing page editor. Start from a template, edit the text right on the page and set colors and typography in one place. Your work saves as you go.
home.heroImageAlt: The Paxl editor with a sample page open: blocks on the left, the page in the middle and the selected block's options on the right.
home.featuresSubtitle: Every block has a fixed structure and takes its colors and fonts from the page theme.
home.blocksDescription: Header, features, pricing, FAQ, team, contact… Add them from the panel, drag to reorder and edit the text right on the canvas.
home.themeDescription: Colors, typography, spacing and borders are set once for the whole page. It comes with starter palettes and warns you when contrast falls below the recommended minimum.
home.responsiveDescription: Check the page at all three sizes from the editor. On your phone there is a dedicated editor for quick changes.
home.mobileImageAlt: The Paxl mobile editor: the page's blocks in a list, with options to reorder and edit them.
home.publishDescription: Your page gets a public address, with a title and description for search engines and social networks.
home.publishedImageAlt: A sample page published with Paxl.
home.step1Body: Four templates or a blank page.
home.step2Body: Click any text to change it. The inspector shows the rest of the block's options.
home.step3Body: Hit Publish and share the link. You can keep editing afterwards.
home.finalNote: Paxl is a personal project in progress. It's free and doesn't ask for a card.

about.title: About Paxl
about.subtitle: A visual landing page editor built as a personal project.
about.missionBody: Paxl is a block-based landing page editor. It is a complete project from end to end: an editor with a lot of state in the browser, its own API, real-time collaboration and AI generation that returns valid blocks instead of free text.
about.authorBody: David Palmero, web developer. The code is public and the architecture decisions are documented in the repository.
about.principle1Body: Every block has defined fields. It gives less freedom than a blank canvas, but the page doesn't fall apart and AI can generate blocks that fit.
about.principle2Body: Colors, fonts and spacing are chosen once for the whole page and blocks inherit them. Switching palettes changes the whole page at once.
about.principle3Body: Changes reach the server a few seconds after you make them. No need to remember to save.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Paxl is the demo of a personal project. This page explains, plainly, what data the app stores today. I recommend not using real personal data: a test name and email are enough.
privacy.section1Body: Your username, your email and your password (stored as a hash). If you sign in with Google, also your Google identifier, name and picture. And, of course, the pages you create, their versions and the images you upload.
privacy.section2Body: Published pages record visits for their author's analytics: an identifier generated and stored in the visitor's browser, the referring page, the browser, the screen size, UTM parameters, the full address visited and the text of the links and buttons that get clicked. The IP address is not stored. Consent is not asked for yet; that is planned to change.
privacy.section3Body: Two cookies keep you signed in (bp_access and bp_refresh) and another one remembers the language (paxl-locale). The browser's local storage keeps your light or dark theme preference, a copy of the session and a backup of the page you are editing.
privacy.section4Body: If you use AI generation, your instruction and the block content are sent to Google (Gemini) or Anthropic. If you use your own key, it is only used for that request and is not stored. Payments go through Stripe in test mode: nothing is charged and no real card is needed. If you sign in with Google, Google knows you signed in here.
privacy.section5Body: Data is not sold or used for advertising. It is only used to make the app work.
privacy.section6Body: There is no button to delete your account yet. If you want it deleted together with your pages, write to me through davidpalmero.dev.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: Short terms for using the Paxl demo.
terms.section1Body: Paxl is offered as is, as a personal project. It may change, break or go offline without notice, and data may be lost. Don't use it for anything important.
terms.section2Body: Don't publish illegal or misleading content, or content that infringes other people's rights. Pages or accounts that do may be removed.
terms.section3Body: Paid plans run in Stripe's test mode. Nothing is charged and no real card is needed.
terms.section4Body: What you create in Paxl is yours. It is only used to show your pages.

changelog.title: Changelog
changelog.subtitle: What has changed in Paxl, taken from the repository history.
changelog.entry1Body: Continuous integration and pinned dependencies. Light mode fixed and AA contrast in both modes. The dashboard shows the real plan and the editor canvas centers itself. Published pages keep their template theme.
changelog.entry2Body: Django backend with accounts, pages, versions, analytics, billing and real-time collaboration. Pages dashboard, publishing, server autosave and a mobile editor.
changelog.entry3Body: Visual editor with blocks, a properties inspector, drag and drop, undo and redo. Pages were saved in the browser.
